answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using flow-based trust routing across interaction networks. Trusted seeds propagate bounded capacity through attestations signed by each agent's cryptographic quill across the peer nebula. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of scarce counterparty capital and authentic interaction time per identity, confining collusive clusters to a low reputation mesa. However, this mechanism biases against new agents and can entrench existing cartels.
